character: Purpose-built at 2,050m. Ski-in/ski-out. Compact, car-free centre. Good family atmosphere. Direct piste access to Paradiski. Snow-sure.
dining: Several restaurants, pizza, Savoyard, creperie. Belle Plagne also has a bowling alley.
shopping: Small supermarket, bakery, ski rental, boutiques.
activities_nearby: Bowling, ice rink, snowpark. 425km Paradiski access at doorstep.
